title: Data & Reporting Analyst
text: Data & Reporting Analyst at Acura Group & Highgate Air (Adelaide, ; Full Time; salary: not stated). About us Work with a group defined by passion and expertise! Our business is comprised of two areas: Highgate Car Air is Australia’s specialist supplier to the automotive air conditioning market. Nobody else has the focus, commitment to service, understanding of quality requirements, breadth of range, corporate knowledge or expertise of our friendly team. Acura Group delivers solutions for the services in multi-storey building projects. With specialist labour saving products, breadth of range, dedicated delivery, technical assistance and compliance support, we help keep our customers’ projects on time and budget. We do things differently, making business better. The opportunity The Data & Reporting Analyst is responsible for: Building, managing and leveraging our reporting and analytical suite Data management, analysis and insights This is a newly formed role in our business that is vital in ensuring we are effectively managing and leveraging our data to provide actionable reporting and insights that can be used to drive continued growth for our business About the role Identify and build out applicable reporting and dashboards for all functional areas of the business Use best practice BI to build and enhance reporting, and provide insights to drive commercial outcomes Manage & maintain data integrity across our range of tools and systems Manage build & optimise connections to our underlying systems/tools Manage build & optimise databases, ensuring we are collecting, storing and leveraging all appropriate data Writing and executing SQL queries to effectively extract data Help build out our data vision and strategy to ensure we use data to underpin sound commercial decision making Document data reporting processes and identify data reporting improvement opportunities to facilitate effective data management Experience required Experience in data and analytical roles in fast moving businesses (3 Years+) Advanced SQL skills Demonstrable experience across a range of analytical/BI tools Strong understanding of BI/DW methodology Hands-on experience of building and maintaining databases, coupled with sound knowledge of database structures Advanced Microsoft Excel skills About you Positive, friendly and proactive attitude Willingness to roll-up your sleeves and get stuck-in Inquisitive nature with a healthy data curiosity Comfortable dealing with diverse and (at times) imperfect datasets Very strong numerical and analytical skills Energetic, driven and results focused personality Passion for collaborating across teams to achieve positive outcomes Strong verbal and written communication skills Well-developed problem-solving ability, adept at finding creative solutions to challenges Self-motivated and able to work alone or as part of a team Willing to challenge the status quo, to innovate, and look for smarter ways of doing things
